name: NGC 5872 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5872, a very massive relic galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5872-hubble
story: A rare survivor: a very massive elliptical galaxy counted among the relic galaxies, nearby stand-ins for massive galaxies seen far back in cosmic time. Hubble mapped its light to help trace the mass in its inner regions.

claims.text: NGC 5872 is a very massive relic galaxy
Massive relic galaxies are local analogs of high-redshift compact galaxies
Hubble measured its surface brightness profile to map its inner mass
